claim_limits.measured: 2024 WDS electron-microprobe REE oxide means retain species/specimen/n and units; exact values are prose, not mg/kg observation objects.
claim_limits.calculated: Water and CO2 calculated due material scarcity; IR only supports hydration qualitatively. Crystallographic proxies/constraints and poor crystal quality are explicit.
claim_limits.nulls: Below-detection entries remain censored and are not zeros; YLa Ce below detection is not literal absence.
claim_limits.scale: Natural geological occurrence and laboratory characterization only. Qualitative HCl effervescence has no concentration/time/yield; no recovery or deployment claim.
claim_limits.criticality: Not assessed; no host-mineral inheritance from Y, Ce or La.

2024 Table4 C4/C5/C6 coordinate labels are permuted relative to the official CIF; detailed label-specific bonding is not imported.

Ideal oxide-composition prose labels the 27.40 wt% carbon dioxide equivalent as CO3, whereas analytical Table1 uses CO2; owner uses authority formula and qualified measured REE oxides, not that prose token.

2026 follow-up Figures1–2 and p.428 identify YCe cores, intermediate YCe/AliceYCe zones and NdCe rims. This sampling qualification is retained; its explicitly mixed diffraction model is not substituted for the 2024 YCe model.
alicewilsonite-yla: Table4 O19b coordinates 0.763(4),0.657(4),0.699(5) appear under CIF O20A, and further water labels are permuted. The owner explicitly withholds label-specific bonding.
Main-text ideal oxide calculation says CO3 30.59 wt%, while Table1 uses CO2 for its calculated 29.78 wt%; this prose token is excluded.
Figure3 labels La6 whereas the text/Table4/CIF label the La-dominant site La3; site-label comparison is not treated as an independent elemental assay.
CIF model-density 3.453 and paper empirical-formula density 3.37 g/cm3 use different composition representations; neither is a measured density and neither is curated.

CIF sphere radius 0.400 mm exceeds the listed 0.044 mm maximum crystal dimension; deposit/processing clarification is needed before reusing absorption geometry. No absorption coefficient or transmission-derived claim curated.
